notes: Official sources could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and textbookcorp.tn.gov.in refuse the fetch tool (robots.txt); tnschools.gov.in and scert.tnschools.gov.in are JavaScript apps that return no content to the fetch tool; the sandbox shell has no internet access. All chapter information comes from secondary sites, so every chapter is verified:false.

EDITION CHANGE: for 2026-27, Classes 1-3 use NEW textbooks written for Tamil Nadu's revised curriculum (State Education Policy, launched Aug 2025). The Minister released the Term 1 books on 18/19 May 2026 (DT Next, News Today). Term 2 books, also new, were printed in Sept 2026 and handed out when schools reopened on 5 Oct 2026. SCERT trained master trainers on 7-8 Oct 2026 (Rc. No. 2640773/F1/2026, dated 03.10.2026). As of 2026-10-19 no source says whether Term 3 will also be new; it probably will be. The earlier (2019-era, Ennum Ezhuthum-aligned) Term 1-3 books are superseded for 2026-27.

ENNUM EZHUTHUM: the mission continues in 2026-27. Weekly teacher log books for Classes 1-3 carry the heading 'Ennum Ezhuthum' and index lessons against the new textbook and a separate Teacher's Handbook (THB). Ennum Ezhuthum lesson plans for 2026-27 also exist for Classes 4-5. DT Next (7 May 2026) reports that the separate Ennum Ezhuthum workbook has been merged into the new Classes 1-3 textbook.

STRUCTURE OF NEW BOOKS: lessons are numbered unit.lesson (for example 'Unit 2.6', 'Unit 2.8', 'Unit 1.1') and carry story-like titles. Unit-level titles were not found in any source, so chapters here are recorded as 'Unit N' and their sections hold the lesson titles found. Only some lessons could be identified. These chapter lists are therefore INCOMPLETE and every one is verified:false. Lesson titles seen in English are flagged as such. The others come from Tamil-medium log books: the Tamil text is given with a translated gloss, and the printed English-medium titles may be worded differently.

BUNDLING CONFLICT: tnupdates.com says Maths is a separate book in Classes 1 and 3 and combined with EVS in Class 2. tnkalvi.net labels Term 1 files 'Maths & EVS' (Classes 1, 2) and 'Maths, Science & Social' (Class 3). freetnbooks.com and tntextbooks.in list Mathematics separately. The SCERT Term 2 training lists Mathematics as its own subject group. Not resolved.

The new Term 1 English-medium maths PDFs exist on Google Drive mirrors (tnupdates.com, tnkalvi.net), but Drive blocks the fetch tool, so no table of contents could be read. The next step is to open the Term 1 and Term 2 PDFs (or the official site in a browser) and replace the placeholder units with the printed unit and lesson titles.

Outcomes are given only where a lesson title makes the mathematics clear ('total' = addition, 'remaining/left' = subtraction). Number ranges are not known. Units whose content could not be determined have no outcomes rather than invented ones.

Grade 1 evidence: Term 1 lesson 2.6 (THB pp. 27-31, textbook pp. 48-57) in week 9 and lesson 2.8 in week 13 (a reinforcement/remedial week). Term 2 started with lesson 1.1 in the week of 5 Oct 2026. 'Unit 1' of Term 1 exists, since Unit 2 follows it, but its title and content were not found. Term 1 Unit 2 lessons 2.1-2.5 and 2.7, any Term 1 units after Unit 2, all of Term 2 after lesson 1.1, and all of Term 3 are unknown.
The Term 2 lesson 1.1 title does not show its maths content, so it has no outcomes.
